svg.aria-label: Sequence diagram of a put over an existing key: Client, Node, Hot tier, Cold tier. The node takes the entry of the key, reads both tiers, evaluates If-None-Match and If-Match against the tags of the current version, declares the replacement on the entry, replaces the hot object atomically on its tag, then moves the entry to PENDING with a compare-and-swap, which is the acknowledgement point. The leader later replaces the cold copy.
svg.title: An overwrite: take the entry, find the key, check the condition, replace in hot, then acknowledge
svg.text: An overwrite: take the entry, find the key, check the condition, replace in hot, then acknowledge
Client
Node
Hot tier
Cold tier
0 PUT key (streamed body)
optional If-None-Match: * or If-Match: "tag"
1 create _entries/<sha256(key)>, create-only
the entry (PUT, HELD, this node); on EXISTS see the take table
created
2a hot HEAD key (under the entry)
2b cold HEAD key: the key exists in one tier or both
3 Conditions, decided here, under the entry. Key absent in both tiers: If-Match is 404 NoSuchKey, else this is a new-key put (the put diagram).
Key present: If-None-Match: * is 412 and the entry is freed. If-Match is 412 unless the tag is one of the tags of the current version (section 4).
A cold tier that cannot be asked: free the entry, 503 (fails closed, as for a new key).
4 CAS the entry, If-Match: (PUT,HELD) to (PUT,HELD,replace)
declares that the cold copy, if any, is the older version
5 replace key in hot, If-Match on the tag from 2a, streamed
(object absent in hot: create-only; hot Full: the cold path)
durable: readers see the old object or the new one, whole
6 CAS the entry: (PUT,HELD,replace) to (PUT,PENDING,replace)
the CAS is the acknowledgement point
7 200 with the ETag of the new object: ACK POINT
After the ack, hot holds the new version and a PENDING replace entry; cold still holds the old version (or nothing). Every read finds the new
version in hot. The leader finds the entry by LIST, copies hot over cold with If-Match on the cold tag (or create-only if cold has none), seals
and removes the entry (entry lifecycle). Eviction takes no key that has an entry, so the old cold version is never served after the ack. If step
4, 5 or 6 does not finish, the entry is reaped to PENDING and the leader copies whatever hot holds over cold. A 503 after step 5 is an unknown
outcome: the key may hold either version.
